name: Box
dimensions: Depth 10.0 cm; Height 7.0 cm; Width 12.7 cm
summary: This box is an example of a centuries-old Chinese lacquering technique. The lacquer worker slowly builds up alternate layers of red and black lacquer on a wood core and then carves through to reveal a scrolling pattern. This pattern had been popular in China from the 13th century through to the 20th
